reason: Reply para 3's cave-animal diversity argument answers Murray's cave-animal remarks (paras 3, 10); only the closing thanks responds to the reference list in paras 5-9.
Reply para 2 rebuts Lyell's para 1 points on Deinosaurian free will and on grouping Huxley's 'matter & force' with natural selection.
Reply para 8 answers Lyell's para 8 question on whether the land or marine Amblyrhynchus came first and where it came from.
Reply para 5 is only the valediction 'My dear Sir | Yours very faithfully | C. Darwin'; Scott's self-impregnation question is answered in reply para 3.
Hooker's para 1 on Goodenia's viscid surface and pollen not penetrating prompts Darwin's reply para 1 suspicion that the Leschenaultia surface is stigma.
Reply para 7 ('no consolatory view on the dignity of man') directly answers Lyell's paras 1-10 on man's dignity and progressive consolation.
Reply para 4 answers Lyell's para 4 question whether Hooker had written about few peculiar Arctic/Greenland forms and his explanation.
Answer about Horace leaving Clapham School does not occur in Darwin's reply to Tegetmeier (transcript 0374), which concerns woodcuts and Wells.
Reply para 1 formally acknowledges election as Correspondent announced in Stewardson's paras 1-5; para 2 is just the address line.
Reply para 2 on hive-bees sucking withered or small clover flowers responds to Hardy's para 2 on smaller second-growth flowers.
Reply para 1 reacts to Lyell's news (paras 1-2) that Barrande's primordial/Cambrian is increasingly separated from Lower Silurian.
Reply para 2 thanks Smith for the Pompilus wing gradations and asks about Calathus, both from incoming para 3.
Reply para 1 praises Lyell's remarks as new and says 'I will run through them', referring to objections in paras 3-8 absent from the question.
Only 'The facts are really grand' answers Falconer's Sicilian cave news (paras 2-5); most of reply para 1 is Darwin's own family-illness news and visit plans.
Reply para 3 agrees with Lyell's paras 5-6 view that most species are immutable and only a few become modified.
Reply para 2 opens on being unable to hear from his son about the farm before the sale (incoming paras 3-5), not just the Alford visit of para 6.
Reply paras 2-3 question whether style curvature is mere growth, responding to Hooker's paras 6-7 force-of-growth explanation.
Reply para 2 enjoying Owen's 'good setting down' reacts to Falconer's para 1 account of Huxley at Oxford.
Reply para 2 on whether Owen avows the Review answers Hooker's para 2 report from Bell.
Answer about 'purple nuts' does not occur in Darwin's reply to Rawson (transcript 0222), which discusses Primrose pistils, Gladiolus and Cypripedium.
Answer declining electrotypes does not occur in Darwin's reply to Fox (transcript 0211), which concerns the Ram, Musk ducks and Malvern.
Reply para 3 on hound versus human gestation and multiple origins answers Lyell's paras 2-3.
Reply paras 1, 5-7 entrust the Anwick purchase and payment arrangements to Higgins, answering his paras 1-5 on valuation, auction and deposit.
Reply paras 2-4 and 7 on Owen's spite and Sedgwick's Phil. Soc. attack respond to Henslow's paras 2-4 about Owen and Sedgwick.
Reply paras 2 and 5 cover bud-variation and Verbascum (Scott's para 10), not the parthenogenesis question in para 4.
Reply para 2 declines the 16 May Geological Society meeting of Lyell's para 3, giving Etty's fever as the reason.
Reply para 2 concedes the danger of admitting a Galapagos-continent connection that Lyell raised in para 3.
Reply para 1 thanks Henslow for the Elodea observations of para 1 and mentions seeking further information.
Reply para 9 opens 'I have said what I can in defence', dangling without the prior answers, and adds unprompted Dogs manuscript news.
Reply para 4 answers a quoted phrase 'extinguished in a given time' that appears nowhere in Lyell's para 7 or elsewhere in the letter.
Reply para 4 adds the pig story and Wyman's striped horses from Gray's July 10 note, absent from the diœcio-dimorphous paragraph given.
Reply para 1 defends the statement about hive bees and red clover that Hardy's para 1 disputes.
Reply para 6 on the impertinence of Royalty asking Hooker to lecture answers Hooker's para 5 royal-lecture news and secrecy request.
Reply para 1 thanks Hooker for settling Leschenaultia stigma (paras 1-4) and asks about Brown's remarks (para 5).
Reply para 1 thanks Williams & Norgate for the French dictionary information in their para 1.
Reply para 6 addresses New Zealand bats not becoming non-volant, raised in Lyell's paras 6-7.
Only 'I blundered about the Ant-insect' answers para 10; the extended praise of Murray's generosity to an antagonist responds to his concessions in paras 1-3.
Reply para 1 on measuring cells once Smith finalises the Jamaica bee identification answers incoming para 1.
Reply para 6 is only the valediction 'Farewell my kind friend | Yours most truly | C. Darwin'.
Postscript that Waterhouse wants to see the common-to-drone cell gradation responds to Smith's paras 1-2 offer of the graded comb.
Reply para 1 thanks Murray and clarifies prepotency and 'marrying hermaphrodite opposites', both from Murray's paras 1-2.
Reply para 3 is only the valediction 'My good old friend | Yours most truly | C. Darwin'.
Reply para 7 on Etty's fever returning answers Hooker's para 1 relief at Etty's good news and question about change of air.
Reply paras 3-5 give Darwin's curved-style and nectary facts, including Rhododendron, answering Hooker's paras 3-4.
Reply para 3 explains why atolls would not retain mammals, answering Lyell's para 3 atoll objection.
Reply para 1 reacts to Huxley's Von Baer news (paras 1-3) and asks that Von Baer send anything he publishes.
Reply para 4 on no reptile becoming a mammal and a single mammalian progenitor answers Lyell's paras 4-5.
Reply para 2 thanks Murray for the 'abominable animal' note mentioned in his para 3.
Reply para 1 opens on not showing Lyell's letter to Hooker, and para 8 attacks a 'distinct successive types' quote; neither appears in paras 1-4, 10.
Reply para 4 thanks Hooker for the Leschenaultia and Scævola stigma homologies in his paras 2-3.
Reply para 5 is only the valediction 'With hearty thanks for your letter | Believe me | Yours very sincerely'.
Reply para 7 on the polar bear case and no incipient shore-feeding seals answers Lyell's para 7 seal objection.
Question is Hooker's valediction (para 5); reply paras 2-3 on photographs, Mrs Cameron and Tennyson are not prompted by it.
Reply para 5 on the antiquity of islands and the Canary miocene shells responds to Lyell's paras 4, 6-7.
